finding.source: Owner raised this point after the initial review; independently confirmed from frozen source without runtime.
finding.trigger: A timed checked_request times out, killing its engine. The timed handler records status=timeout and the original error; the subsequent postflight against that exited engine raises again.
finding.effect: Postflight row.update overwrites the original timeout status/error with failed and a generic already-exited error. Incomplete calibration/blocks survive, but the first exception text and classification are lost. No false-passed cohort is possible from this path.
finding.required_fix: Preserve the first failure status/error and append a distinct postflight error or ordered failure history; a postflight failure after a measured row must still fail that row/cohort.
finding.location: validation/collier-reference/run.py timed-row and postflight exception handlers
